from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# ---------- INSPECT ----------
# Keep one workbook for saving and one data_only workbook for reading calculated values if any formulas exist.
wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
wb_vals = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)

ws = wb["Sheet1"]
ws_vals = wb_vals["Sheet1"]

# Determine the real non-empty dimensions for inspection.
real_max_row = 0
real_max_col = 0
for sheet in wb.worksheets:
    for row in sheet.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                real_max_row = max(real_max_row, cell.row)
                real_max_col = max(real_max_col, cell.column)

print("Sheet1 apparent dimension:", ws.calculate_dimension())
print("Workbook real max row/col:", real_max_row, get_column_letter(real_max_col) if real_max_col else None)

# Print relevant used values from Sheet1.
sheet1_max_row = 0
sheet1_max_col = 0
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value is not None:
            sheet1_max_row = max(sheet1_max_row, cell.row)
            sheet1_max_col = max(sheet1_max_col, cell.column)

for r in range(1, sheet1_max_row + 1):
    print(r, [ws_vals.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, sheet1_max_col + 1)])

            last_data_row = max(last_data_row, r)

total = 0

for r in range(1, last_data_row + 1):
    row_values = [ws_vals.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, 6)]  # A:E
    if any(v == reference for v in row_values):
        numeric_values = [
            v for v in row_values
            if isinstance(v, numbers.Number) and not isinstance(v, bool)
        ]
        row_sum = sum(numeric_values)
        total += row_sum
        matched_rows.append((r, row_values, numeric_values, row_sum))

# Cell-level manipulation: write only H2.
ws["H2"] = total

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# ---------- VERIFY ----------
verify_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
verify_ws = verify_wb["Sheet1"]

print("Reference from G2:", reference)
print("Matched rows / numeric contributions:")
for item in matched_rows:
    print(item)

print("Computed total:", total)
print("Saved H2:", verify_ws["H2"].value)

assert verify_ws["H2"].value == total
print("Verification passed.")
